BETA Close X Barratt Redrow plc has announced the purchase of 2,999,999 ordinary shares for cancellation as part of its £386 million share repurchase program. These transactions occurred between July 27 and July 31, 2026, with shares bought on the London Stock Exchange from Barclays Bank plc at prices ranging from 290.20 pence to 300.20 pence per share. Following these purchases, Barratt Redrow holds no ordinary shares in treasury, and its total issued ordinary shares stand at 1,403,360,974, representing the total voting rights. Disclaimer* Barratt Redrow PLC 03 August 2026 3 August 2026 Barratt Redrow plc Transaction in Own Shares Barratt Redrow plc, ISIN: GB0000811801 (the "Company", "Barratt Redrow") announces that during the period from 27 July 2026 to 31 July 2026 (the "Disclosure Period") it has purchased for cancellation the following number of ordinary shares of 10 pence each from Barclays Bank plc ("Barclays") as part of its £386 million share repurchase programme announced on 15 July 2026 (the "Programme"). All shares were purchased from Barclays as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE"). Following the above purchases and cancellation of the ordinary shares, the Company holds no ordinary shares in treasury and has 1,403,360,974 ordinary shares in issue. The total number of voting rights in the Company is therefore 1,403,360,974.
